name: zmodel_const_remove_colinear_vertices_in_place
description: zModel_Const::RemoveColinearVerticesInPlace repeatedly removes interior colinear vertices from the point array and reports whether any vertex was removed.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the zModel polygon/source-cluster pass because this helper depends on x87 comparison shape and caller-side polygon preprocessing.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x482b40 validates the fastcall ABI with vertexCount in ecx, points in edx, and three unused trailing stack arguments.

Binary Ninja assembly validates the repeated scan over vertex triplets, calling zModel_Const::SetNormalizedCrossFromVertexTriplet, removing currentVertex only when all normal components compare below g_zModel_ColinearTolerance, shifting only the points array, decrementing vertexCount, and returning whether any vertex was removed.
The native smoke verifies no-removal behavior for a non-colinear triangle and in-place removal/shift behavior for a polygon containing one colinear interior vertex.
